name: theflyingrabbit
summary: This Tomball shopping center features Hobby Lobby as its anchor tenant, offering comprehensive arts, crafts, and home décor selections along the Tomball Parkway corridor. The center serves northwest Houston's suburban families with extensive creative supplies, seasonal merchandise, and rotating weekly sales of up to 50% off.
demographics: The shopping center serves the Tomball, Texas community, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and homeowners in the northwest Houston metropolitan area. The primary trade area consists of suburban residents aged 30-65 with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000, including young families, DIY enthusiasts, and craft hobbyists. Shoppers typically visit for project-based purchases, seasonal decorations, and home improvement needs, with strong weekend traffic from families engaged in creative activities and home décor projects.
description: Located at 27708 Tomball Parkway in Tomball, Texas, this shopping center is anchored by Hobby Lobby, one of America's leading arts and crafts retailers. The center serves the growing northwest Houston suburban community with a focus on creative living, home décor, and DIY projects. Hobby Lobby offers an extensive selection across multiple departments including home décor, seasonal items, fabric and sewing supplies, yarn and needle arts, floral and wedding supplies, arts and crafts materials, and party supplies. The store features rotating weekly sales with discounts up to 50% off on various departments, making it a destination for budget-conscious shoppers seeking quality craft and home goods. With convenient access along Tomball Parkway and extended operating hours from early morning to late evening, the center provides easy accessibility for families and creative enthusiasts throughout the greater Tomball area. The location benefits from the area's continued residential growth and strong community focus on family activities and home improvement projects.
